content: Blood pressure should be assessed during every routine clinical visit for youth with type 1 diabetes. If elevated blood pressure is detected—defined as being at or above the 90th percentile for age, sex, and height, or at or above 120/80 mmHg in adolescents aged 13 years or older—it should be confirmed by measurements taken on three separate occasions. In cases where elevated blood pressure persists, ambulatory blood pressure monitoring should be considered to further evaluate the condition.
